Starship Troopers: Terran Command collects gameplay data and error logs to assist with improving the quality of the game.

Disable the checkbox below if you want to opt out.

When a unit reaches experience level 3 - indicated by the 3 dots above the unit emblem - it can be assigned an Elite special ability. Several options are available per unit type but you can only choose one.

To assign an elite ability, follow these steps:
• Select a level 3 unit
• Click the "Choose Elite Ability" command button
• Choose and click on one of the available elite ability buttons
• The new ability will now be available for the unit
